description: Build base64 UNSIGNED Sui transaction bytes for a swap on the chosen venue, with the sender set to your address and an on-chain minimum-out from slippage_bps. The bytes are simulated against mainnet before return. You sign locally and submit yourself; nothing is executed by the desk. Non-custodial: the desk never sees or holds keys and never moves funds; it returns quotes and UNSIGNED transactions only. Spot only, no leverage. Education only, not financial advice.

amount.description: Amount of the from coin in human units, e.g. 2.5

from.description: Coin symbol: SUI, USDC, WAL, DEEP, CETUS

route.description: DeepBook only: route string from get_swap_quote, e.g. 'SUI_USDC -> WAL_USDC'

sender.description: YOUR Sui address (0x...). Public address only; never send a key.

simulate.description: Simulate the unsigned bytes against mainnet (no signature, nothing executed)

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage in basis points (50 = 0.5%); tx reverts below min_out

name: build_swap_tx
title: Build UNSIGNED swap transaction
